review.gallery: Eight official project brochure renders and one dated developer site photo. The named two-tower exterior leads the gallery and card. The construction photograph is labelled with the month and year.
review.location: Ellington’s original aerial map identifies Mercer House off First Al Khail Street. The broker point falls within the approximate development area. Fourteen times match the developer brochure. The North Tower brief also gives eight minutes to Ain Dubai.
review.floorPlans: Forty-two complete drawings: 11 residential or duplex sheets and six floor plates per tower, plus eight amenity drawings. The North brief adds the missing 40th and 41st floor plates and both duplex levels. Common podium and ground layouts repeat across tower amenities packs and are represented once. The North penthouse components sum to 9,477.09 sq ft against the printed 9,477.08. Other penthouse configurations and live unit variations are not inferred from the examples.

unavailable: Surveyed visitor entrances, a separate North floor 22 drawing, separate basement and podium 1 layouts, drawings for every contracted penthouse area and photographed completed interiors.
